    def __init__(self):
        self.students = {}  # maps grade -> set of student names
        self.all_students = set()  # tracks all student names ever added
        self.add_results = []  # tracks success/failure of each add_student call

    def add_student(self, name, grade):
        # Check if student is already in the school (any grade)
        if name in self.all_students:
            self.add_results.append(False)
            return
        
        # Add student to the grade
        if grade not in self.students:
            self.students[grade] = set()
        
        self.students[grade].add(name)
        self.all_students.add(name)
        self.add_results.append(True)

    def roster(self):
        # Return all students sorted by grade, then by name within each grade
        result = []
        for grade in sorted(self.students.keys()):
            result.extend(sorted(self.students[grade]))
        return result

    def grade(self, grade_number):
        # Return students in a specific grade, sorted by name
        if grade_number not in self.students:
            return []
        return sorted(self.students[grade_number])

    def added(self):
        # Return list of success/failure for each add_student call
        return self.add_results
